title: Identity and pasting for ordinary ambient ringed exchange
statement: Let d be the Noetherian adic coefficient datum of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Write P_u=Lu^* and R_u=Ru_* for its ambient completed-coefficient ordinary derived operations, and E_σ:P_g R_f→R_f′ P_g′ for ordinary ringed exchange [def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange]. Let c_(h,g):P_(h≫g)≅P_h P_g, i_T:P_id≅id and p_(f,e):R_e R_f≅R_(f≫e), r_T:R_id≅id be the normalized comparisons of [lem-weil-pbc-completed-ordinary-comparisons]. Then the following equations hold on every ambient input K, without properness or completeness hypotheses. (1) For a square with horizontal identity edges and vertical edge f, E(K)=i_Y(R_fK) ≫ R_f(i_X(K)⁻¹). (2) For a square with vertical identity edges and horizontal edge g, E(K)=P_g(r_V(K)) ≫ r_U(P_gK)⁻¹. (3) For horizontally adjacent cartesian squares σ₁=(f,f′,g,g′), σ₂=(f′,f″,h,h′) and any outer cartesian realization σ, E_σ(K)=c_(h,g)(R_fK) ≫ P_h(E_σ₁(K)) ≫ E_σ₂(P_g′K) ≫ R_f″(c_(h′,g′)(K)⁻¹). (4) For vertically adjacent cartesian squares σ₁=(f,f′,g,g′), σ₂=(e,e′,k,g) and any outer cartesian realization σ, E_σ(K)=P_k(p_(f,e)(K)⁻¹) ≫ E_σ₂(R_fK) ≫ R_e′(E_σ₁(K)) ≫ p_(f′,e′)(P_g′K). Composition is written in Lean order. Each square includes the actual coefficient identifications induced by d.

proof.text: The sectionwise direct-image identity and composition maps are restrictions along the canonical fiber-product maps. Their unit and associativity equations hold sectionwise. Tensor-unit adjunction conjugation gives the pullback equations. Their exact derived factorization, or their normalization on flat-term K-flat representatives, transports those equations to derived pullback.

proof.text: The outer pullback square is the paste of the two inner comparisons. Apply the vertical and horizontal composition laws for mates, and then change composite adjunctions by their conjugate isomorphisms. For identity squares the same unit-square-counit expression reduces by the triangle identities. These are the four stated equations.

theorem AdicCoefficientDatum.integralExchange_coherence :
    (∀ {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
      (sq : ChosenCartesianSquare (𝟙 X) f f (𝟙 Y)) (K : d.derived X),
      (d.integralExchange sq).app K =
        (d.pullId Y).hom.app ((d.push f).obj K) ≫
          (d.push f).map ((d.pullId X).inv.app K)) ∧
    (∀ {U V : Scheme.{t}} (g : U ⟶ V)
      (sq : ChosenCartesianSquare g (𝟙 U) (𝟙 V) g) (K : d.derived V),
      (d.integralExchange sq).app K =
        (d.pull g).map ((d.pushId V).hom.app K) ≫
          (d.pushId U).inv.app ((d.pull g).obj K)) ∧
    (∀ {X X' X'' Y Y' Y'' : Scheme.{t}}
      {f : X ⟶ Y} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {f'' : X'' ⟶ Y''}
      {g : Y' ⟶ Y} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {h : Y'' ⟶ Y'} {h' : X'' ⟶ X'}
      (sq₁ : ChosenCartesianSquare g' f' f g)
      (sq₂ : ChosenCartesianSquare h' f'' f' h)
      (outer : ChosenCartesianSquare (h' ≫ g') f'' f (h ≫ g)) (K : d.derived X),
      (d.integralExchange outer).app K =
        (d.pullComp h g).hom.app ((d.push f).obj K) ≫
          (d.pull h).map ((d.integralExchange sq₁).app K) ≫
            (d.integralExchange sq₂).app ((d.pull g').obj K) ≫
              (d.push f'').map ((d.pullComp h' g').inv.app K)) ∧
    (∀ {X X' Y Y' Z Z' : Scheme.{t}}
      {f : X ⟶ Y} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {e : Y ⟶ Z} {e' : Y' ⟶ Z'}
      {g' : X' ⟶ X} {g : Y' ⟶ Y} {k : Z' ⟶ Z}
      (sq₁ : ChosenCartesianSquare g' f' f g)
      (sq₂ : ChosenCartesianSquare g e' e k)
      (outer : ChosenCartesianSquare g' (f' ≫ e') (f ≫ e) k) (K : d.derived X),
      (d.integralExchange outer).app K =
        (d.pull k).map ((d.pushComp f e).inv.app K) ≫
          (d.integralExchange sq₂).app ((d.push f).obj K) ≫
            (d.push e').map ((d.integralExchange sq₁).app K) ≫
              (d.pushComp f' e').hom.app ((d.pull g').obj K))
